Change human_review.decision from `suggested` to `accepted` if you agree.

After confirmation, merge only accepted or modified rows back into the formal benchmark draft.

decision_meaning.suggested: AI-prepared recommendation, not yet confirmed by human.
decision_meaning.accepted: Human confirmed the suggestion as final.
decision_meaning.modified: Human changed one or more suggested fields.
decision_meaning.rejected: Human rejected the suggestion and plans to keep original draft labeling.
